input.quote: 14.3 Liquidated Damages. In the event that Array (a) [ * ] during [ * ], or (b) intentionally conceals or falsifies a material result and/or material item of data concerning the safety or efficacy of the Product
input.rationale: The only liquidated damages provision in the Agreement (Section 14.3) runs in our favour: it is triggered by Array's failure or data concealment and, at Ono's election, relieves Ono of its diligence obligations and reduces the otherwise applicable royalty rate (p0671). That is an LD benefiting us as Customer, which the rule expressly treats as compliant and not to be redlined. We found no liquidated damages, penalty, minimum-fee-on-termination or early-termination fee payable by Ono: Article VI contains only ordinary upfront and milestone consideration, Article XIV imposes no termination payment on Ono (Section 14.5 preserves only milestones/royalties accrued before termination), and the payment terms in Article VII (p0463) provide only customary interest on late payments, which the detection guidance excludes from penalty treatment. The document therefore meets the preferred position of no Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties.
